integration.show_credit: Display author, linked source page and linked license alongside each image or in an accessible photo-credit panel.
integration.share_alike: For CC BY-SA images, retain the stated license for image adaptations and indicate changes; the image license is separate from the app code.
integration.source_policy: Only individually reviewed Commons public-domain / CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-SA photographs; no 14ers.com photographs copied.
integration.route_scope: Peak-photo coverage is complete. Route-specific coverage is partial and explicitly labeled; photos do not resolve itinerary identity.
